statement: N-0095 keeper change: making a merged record the keeper moves every row from the current keeper to it, redirects the current keeper's other merged records to it, merges the current keeper into it and seals the old keeper's name to it. The new keeper keeps its own code and name and takes the old keeper's status (active when that was merged/inactive). Steward role required; reason required; one transaction; OPEN_CHANNEL always stays keeper (only the repair script may restore it). Options: (a) as built; (b) copy the old keeper's code/name onto the new keeper. Evidence: clone cip_n0095 Amazon 299->26 moved 10786 rows and swapping back restored identical counts. Reversible: yes, by changing the keeper back.
